changeSet.author: security-audit
changeSet.comment: Invalidate legacy non-bcrypt PIN hashes (raw SHA-256 from older builds). Affected users must re-set their PIN via the standard /pin/set flow. Safe under pre-production constraints; do not run on prod without notice.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE users SET pin_hash = NULL, pin_enabled = false, pin_failures = 0, pin_locked_until = NULL, token_version = token_version + 1 WHERE pin_hash IS NOT NULL AND pin_hash NOT LIKE '{bcrypt}%';
